notes_for_editor: Agency conflict: the register says Coos FPA administered the site; Oregon Lookouts files its 1934-1941 record under the Siskiyou National Forest. Neither source gives a change date. Removal: the register says 'removed in 1951' while firelookout.com says 'Destroyed 1951'; not reconciled. No source describes the site today. The 1935 and 1939-1941 staffing entries come from newspaper and planning quotes on Oregon Lookouts. The register and firelookout.com give no access information. Brief record kind 'ground' and elevation 767 m are consistent with the register.
